title: You Don't Need More Leads. You Need to Go Back to the Ones Who Already Said Maybe.
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Your next few clients probably already know your name.
They enquired once, went quiet, and nobody went back for them.
Silence is almost never a decision — it's usually just bad timing.
You've already paid for these contacts once — in ads, in time.
A short, calm follow-up sequence is competing against near silence.
The full blog post is linked in the comments — go read it.
